facts.text: Under the $100K+ Promise, every admitted student receives a renewable merit scholarship of at least $25,000 annually, totaling $100,000 to $136,000 over four years.

sources.title: The Agnes Scott 100K Promise | Undergraduate Scholarships ...
sources.quote: Through the $100K+ Promise, every student admitted for Fall 2027 will receive a renewable merit scholarship worth at least $25,000 per year, totaling $100,000 to $136,000 over four years.
